key_points: Intel has experienced a sharp decline (~40% since earnings) but recent premarket activity shows a rebound.
CEO Lip-Bu Tan purchased $9.7M of Intel shares, signaling insider confidence.
A top analyst issued a rating update that is broadly positive for Intel.
Media coverage frames Intel as a high‑quality AI infrastructure play amid sectorwide fear.
Market sentiment appears to be shifting from extreme negativity toward a tentative recovery over the next weeks.
